entities.summary: Cynthia Nwadiora, popularly known as Cee-C, is a Nigerian lawyer, actress, model and reality television personality. She appeared as a housemate on the shows Big Brother Naija season 3 and Big Brother Naija season 8. She won the award for Fashion Influencer of the Year at the La Mode Magazine's Green October Event 2018. She has served as a brand ambassador for the fitness brand GetFit.
